text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Valentine's Day is almost here.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (At my old school, I would exchange chocolates with my friends. Valentine's is so much fun!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (But this year feels a little different. And I'm really nervous. I mean, how could I not be…)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oooh! So you're giving chocolates to your trainer, Flower?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! It's my way of expressing thanks for everything Trainer does for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I don't know what kind of chocolates adults like…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mayano, you seem really grown-up, so please give me some advice!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You think I'm grown-up?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! Copy that! ☆ You're in for a safe flight with Captain Maya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Commencing Operation: Enchanting Grown-up Valentine's! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (The days leading up to Valentine's just got a whole lot busier.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Time for our first mission: Grown-up Taste Analysis!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: According to this magazine, adults prefer bitter chocolate with rich, complex flavors!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right, that makes sense…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I've seen my trainer drinking coffee before, too. Perhaps I'll try going for a slightly bitter flavor!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Now for mission two: Playing Mind Games!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Adults never express their honest feelings! I saw a TV show where they said keeping the other person guessing is the best way to get them interested!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mind games, hmm…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Oh! A surprise certainly sounds like fun! A little while back, I saw Trainer get a real shock after running into a colleague unexpectedly…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Despite being so stunned, Trainer was smiling a lot. It was such a wonderful smile too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Maybe I could add a second layer of chocolates to the box? I'll have to think up something clever!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the third and final mission: Crafting an Enchanting Atmosphere!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: When giving someone chocolates, the mood has to be just right! So I researched the most popular grown-up date spots online and sent you a list!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow… Thank you so much! They all look really nice…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Ah, this restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That place caught your eye, did it? The night views are supposed to be really pretty! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… Right across from there is a park full of gorgeous canola flowers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer's never told me directly, but… Let's just say I think my trainer likes pretty things.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'd like to take Trainer there someday…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sorry! That doesn't have anything to do with the restaurant, does it?! Umm, it seems to have a great atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I've noticed this for quite a while, Flower, but you sure pay a lot of attention to your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do you think so?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm always thinking about whether there's anything I can help Trainer with. Maybe that's why?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …I think I've just figured it all out.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Flower! Forget everything you've learned on our missions!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But why? You worked so hard on this operation, Mayano…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well, um, I messed up. It made me really happy when you called me grown-up… and I got fixated on appearances and all that surface-level nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I think you already understand this stuff way more than I do.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So the best strategy is to just go with what feels right to you. I'm sure that's what would make your trainer happiest!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …If that's what you think, then I'll trust your judgment. I'll take your advice and do things my way.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But, Mayano, I think you're wrong about one thing…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You didn't mess up at all! All your missions were so grown-up and made my heart pound with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Also, they were a lot of fun. I can't thank you enough!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you're welcome! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You've got this, Flower! I'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right! Thank you again!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I'll be ready for the big day.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Please accept this gift as a thank-you for always being there for me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I gave Trainer chocolates my way! ♪)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You know what, Mayano? I'll still carry out all the missions!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Why? I had you set on the wrong flight path.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, you were right on target!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I really had no idea how to make a grown-up like my trainer happy with my gift…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But you helped me brainstorm and come up with a lot of great ideas!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And that's why… it's time for Mission Four: Gift Giving, the Flower Way!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll carry out all the missions. That way, I'll be putting your advice to good use, and Trainer and I will both be happy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Flower… You're so kind…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mission complete! You're a high-flying grown-up now, Flower. Get out there and make everything perfect!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I will! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the big day arrives…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I know you've enjoyed my cooking many times until now, but…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A friend helped me come up with the idea for these chocolates, and I think they're my tastiest creation yet!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I made them my own way with just a touch of grown-up flavor. Please enjoy them! ♪
